release_notes:
1. Added dedicated Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) & UET dataLayer integration (microsoft_ads namespace).
2. Standard ecommerce conversion events with event_action, revenue_value, currency, tax, shipping, and coupon parameters.
3. Retail dynamic remarketing support (ecomm_pagetype, ecomm_prodid, ecomm_totalvalue, ecomm_category, ecomm_query).
4. Microsoft Merchant Center (MMC) catalog ID alignment matching active Catalog ID Strategy.
5. Enhanced Conversions customer data (pid) with SHA-256 hashed email and phone.
6. Dedicated platform card with Microsoft branding and granular event routing in Back Office matrix table.
